Later execution-complete `6ccb98cdb55da07bd11bbf0ac4ee9fe2c437b5b3` was records-only and not the probe base.
- **Promise.** Key example 1: workflow defines static `Backend Unit tests` with a matrix; attempt reports `Backend Unit tests (1)` with valid timing; Intent’s CI time without runner waits matches that instance to the workflow job and its duration enters the dependency chain (estimate available, here 70 s with a 30 s dependent Proof).
- **Fault.** `dashboard/server/ciWorkflowJobs.ts`, `workflowJobNameMatcher`: for a static `name:` (no `${{ }}` expression parts), replaced `return matchesDeclaredJobLabel(first, true)` with exact equality `return (name) => name === first`, restoring pre-story static-name matching. Fixture and assertions stayed intact. A shell `trap` restored `git checkout -- dashboard/server/ciWorkflowJobs.ts` on exit.
- **Fault location and change.** Same file, static-name arm of `workflowJobNameMatcher`: matrix/truncation acceptance removed so `Backend Unit tests (1)` no longer binds.
- **Fixture.** `dashboard/backend-tests/intent/ci-time-without-runner-waits.spec.ts`, test “a static-named matrix instance contributes its duration to the chain”: workflow jobs `Backend Unit tests` and dependent `Proof`; reported jobs `Backend Unit tests (1)` (40 s) and `Proof` (30 s).
- **Maintained assertion.** Same test, line 117: `expect(timeWithoutRunnerWaits(...)).toEqual({ milliseconds: 70_000 })`.
- **Run observations.** Focused command (repo root, AC, `caffeinate -s -i`): `npx playwright test --config dashboard/playwright.config.ts backend-tests/intent/ci-time-without-runner-waits.spec.ts --reporter=line`.
  - Baseline: 7 passed (3.3 s). Selected static-named matrix test ran among them.
  - Faulted: 2 failed, 5 passed (994 ms). Intended assertion failed: expected `{ milliseconds: 70000 }`, received `{ reason: "Job “Backend Unit tests (1)” does not match a workflow job definition." }`. Reach evidenced by that exact assertion site and the mismatch reason naming `Backend Unit tests (1)`. A second related failure on the truncated E2E longest-shard → 90 s case showed the same static-arm regression; expression-named and prior fixture cases stayed green.
  - Restoration: after `git checkout -- dashboard/server/ciWorkflowJobs.ts`, `git status --porcelain` again showed only `?? node_modules` (matching pre-probe) and `git diff` for the fault file was empty. The same focused command then passed 7 of 7 (816 ms).
